mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_USER,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_USER,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT),0) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_SERVICE,
(SELECT COUNT(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_SERVICE_COUNT,
(SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_SERVICE,
(SELECT COUNT(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 02 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_SERVICE_COUNT,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ORIGINAL_AMOUNT),0) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_PRIN,
(SELECT COUNT(SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE) FROM (SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_PRIN_COUNT,
(SELECT SUM(ORIGINAL_AMOUNT) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_PRIN,
(SELECT COUNT(SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE) FROM (SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_PRIN_COUNT,
(SELECT SUM(TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT AS TR JOIN ( SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD WHERE SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE = TR.REPAYMENT_DATE) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_BALANCE,
(SELECT COUNT(TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT AS TR JOIN ( SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD WHERE SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE = TR.REPAYMENT_DATE AND TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT > 0) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_BALANCE_COUNT
FROM DUAL

SELECT *, (SELECT COUNT(SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate}) AS ACCUM_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(CU_TABLE.TA_CNT) FROM(SELECT CU.USER_NO, COUNT(CU.WITHDRAW_YN) AS TA_CNT FROM CBCI_USER AS CU WHERE CU.WITHDRAW_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate} GROUP BY CU.USER_NO) AS CU_TABLE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI ON CU_TABLE.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO) AS ACCUM_TN_COUNT FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRI_DATE, COUNT(SEQ) AS TRI_CNT FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI WHERE DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY TRI_DATE) AS TRI_TABLE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CU_TABLE.TA_DATE, CU_TABLE.TA_CNT FROM(SELECT CU.USER_NO, DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TA_DATE, COUNT(CU.WITHDRAW_YN) AS TA_CNT FROM CBCI_USER AS CU WHERE CU.WITHDRAW_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY TA_DATE, CU.USER_NO) AS CU_TABLE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI ON CU_TABLE.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO) AS TA_TABLE ON TRI_TABLE.TRI_DATE = TA_TABLE.TA_DATE
UNION
SELECT *, (SELECT COUNT(SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate}) AS ACCUM_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(CU_TABLE.TA_CNT) FROM(SELECT CU.USER_NO, COUNT(CU.WITHDRAW_YN) AS TA_CNT FROM CBCI_USER AS CU WHERE CU.WITHDRAW_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate} GROUP BY CU.USER_NO) AS CU_TABLE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI ON CU_TABLE.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO) AS ACCUM_TN_COUNT FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRI_DATE, COUNT(SEQ) AS TRI_CNT FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI WHERE DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY TRI_DATE) AS TRI_TABLE RIGHT JOIN (SELECT CU_TABLE.TA_DATE, CU_TABLE.TA_CNT FROM(SELECT CU.USER_NO, DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TA_DATE, COUNT(CU.WITHDRAW_YN) AS TA_CNT FROM CBCI_USER AS CU WHERE CU.WITHDRAW_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY TA_DATE, CU.USER_NO) AS CU_TABLE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI ON CU_TABLE.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO) AS TA_TABLE ON TRI_TABLE.TRI_DATE = TA_TABLE.TA_DATE

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS APPROVAL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS EXPIRATION_DATE, TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI WHERE NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} OR NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS APPROVAL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS EXPIRATION_DATE, TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI WHERE NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND REQUEST_COUNT = 1 OR NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND REQUEST_COUNT = 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(TRI.SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON TRI.SEQ = MUI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_NEW_APPLY,
(SELECT COUNT(TRI.SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON TRI.SEQ = MUI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate} AND TRI.REQUEST_STATUS = 01) AS MONEYBANK_NEW_JUDGE,
(SELECT COUNT(TRI.SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON TRI.SEQ = MUI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate} AND TRI.REQUEST_STATUS = 02) AS MONEYBANK_NEW_CONTRACT,
(SELECT COUNT(TRI.SEQ) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON TRI.SEQ = MUI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate} AND TRI.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN = 'Y') AS MONEYBANK_CONTRACT_END,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ORIGINAL_AMOUNT),0) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_TODAY_PRIN,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT),0) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT AS TR JOIN ( SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD WHERE SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE = TR.REPAYMENT_DATE) AS MONEYBANK_ACCUM_BALANCE,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(FEE_AMOUNT),0) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT AS TR WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') = #{toDate}) AS MONEYBANK_FEE
FROM DUAL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS APPROVAL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS EXPIRATION_DATE FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI WHERE NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate} OR NOT EXPIRATION_DATE IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{toDate}

SELECT AP_TABLE.TOTAL_PAYMENT, DATE_FORMAT(AP_TABLE.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(CON_TABLE.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS APPROVAL_DATE, CON_TABLE.APP_SUM, (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate}) AS APP_ACCUM_SUM, (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 1 AND SEQ = AP_TABLE.SEQ) AS JUDGE_SUM, (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI LEFT JOIN TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI ON MUI.SEQ = TRI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate}) AS APP_TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM (SELECT TRI.SEQ, TRI.TOTAL_PAYMENT, MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO AS MUI LEFT JOIN TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO AS TRI ON MUI.SEQ = TRI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}) AS AP_TABLE
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT TRI.SEQ, TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO WHERE SEQ = TRI.SEQ) AS APP_SUM FROM TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI WHERE REQUEST_STATUS = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}) AS CON_TABLE ON CON_TABLE.SEQ = AP_TABLE.SEQ

SELECT TR.SEQ, DATE_FORMAT(TR.REPAYMENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REPAYMENT_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(TRI.DEPOSIT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DEPOSIT_DATE, TRI.TOTAL_PAYMENT, TR.TOTAL_REPAYMENT_AMOUNT, TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT, TR.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT, TR.FEE_AMOUNT, (SELECT SUM(TOTAL_REPAYMENT_AMOUNT) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') < #{fromDate}) AS ACCUM_REPAY, (SELECT SUM(TR.ORIGINAL_REMAINING_AMOUNT) FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT AS TR JOIN ( SELECT MAX(REPAYMENT_DATE) AS M_REPAYMENT_DATE, SEQ FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(REPAYMENT_DATE , '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{fromDate} GROUP BY SEQ) AS SRD WHERE SRD.M_REPAYMENT_DATE = TR.REPAYMENT_DATE) AS ACCUM_REMAIN FROM TOGETHER_REPAYMENT TR LEFT JOIN TOGETHER_REQUEST_INFO TRI ON TR.SEQ = TRI.SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(TR.REPAYMENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}

SELECT CU.USER_ID , CU.USER_NM , CU.FIRM_NM , CU.FIRM_ID , (SELECT TYPE_NAME FROM CBCI_BIZTYPE CB WHERE CB.TYPE_NO = CU.BUSINESS_TYPE) AS BUSINESS_TYPE , (SELECT SEC_NAME FROM CBCI_SECTOR CS WHERE CS.SEC_NO = CU.SECTORS) AS SECTORS , CU.USER_PHONE , CU.FIRM_TEL , CU.FIRM_ZIP_CODE , CU.FIRM_ADDR FROM CBCI_USER CU WHERE CU.USER_NO = #{USER_NO}

SELECT CU.USER_NM, CU.FIRM_NM, CU.BUSINESS_TYPE, CU.REG_DATE, CU.USER_ID , CU.USER_NM AS REP_NM, CU.USER_PHONE , CU.USER_PHONE , MUI.SEQ, MUI.REQUEST_STATUS , MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE , IFNULL(SELECT MP.PRODUCT_NAME FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.DIVISION = MUI.DIVISION, "-") AS DIVISION, MUI.BUSINESS_PERIOD , MUI.SALES_AMOUNT , MUI.B2B_LIMIT_AMOUNT , MUI.REQUEST_SHOP , LENGTH(MUI.REQUEST_SHOP)-LENGTH(REPLACE(MUI.REQUEST_SHOP, ',', ''))+1 AS SHOP_COUNT , HBBRI.total_payment AS TOTAL_PAYMENT , HBBRI.daily_usage_fee AS DAILY_USAGE_FEE FROM CBCI_USER CU LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON CU.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO HBBRI ON MUI.SEQ = HBBRI.seq WHERE CU.USER_NM = #{USER_NM} AND CU.FIRM_NM = #{FIRM_NM} AND MUI.DIVISION = #{DIVISION} ORDER BY #{ORDER_BY}

SELECT SUM(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS WHERE MUI.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ AND DATE_FORMAT(MUIS.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0)) AS REQ_COUNT, SUM(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ AND DATE_FORMAT(MUIS.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0)) AS EVAL_COUNT, SUM(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ AND DATE_FORMAT(TRIS.approval_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0)) AS CONTRACT_COUNT, SUM(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ AND TRIS.final_repayment_yn = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(TRIS.approval_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0)) AS FIN_COUNT, SUM(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ AND TRIS.final_repayment_yn = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(TRIS.approval_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{prevDate}), 0)) AS RUNNING_COUNT, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(TRS.original_amount) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT TRS ON TRIS.seq = TRS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = TRIS.seq AND DATE_FORMAT(TRS.repayment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0))/1000000, 1) AS ORIGINAL_REPAYED, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(TRS.fee_amount) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT TRS ON TRIS.seq = TRS.seq WHERE MUI.SEQ = TRIS.seq AND DATE_FORMAT(TRS.repayment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{prevDate}), 0))/1000000, 1) AS FEE_REPAYED, ROUND(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SUB_RESULT.repayment_remaining_amount) FROM(SELECT DISTINCT RP.seq, (SELECT MIN(TRS.repayment_remaining_amount) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT TRS WHERE RP.seq = TRS.seq) AS REPAYMENT_REMAINING_AMOUNT FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT RP ) SUB_RESULT), 0)/1000000, 1) AS REMAINING_AMOUNT FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI

SELECT SUM(COUNT) AS COUNT , RESULT_TB.FOR_DATE , RESULT_TB.WEEKCOUNT , RESULT_TB.YEARMONTH , WEEKDAY(RESULT_TB.FOR_DATE) AS WEEKDAY
, SUM(RESULT_TB.TOTAL_PAYMENT) AS AMOUNT , IFNULL((RESULT_TB.PREV_MB_COUNT-RESULT_TB.PREV_WD_COUNT), 0) AS PREV_MB_COUNT , IFNULL(RESULT_TB.PREV_USER_COUNT, 0) AS PREV_USER_COUNT , IFNULL(RESULT_TB.PREV_REUSER_COUNT, 0) AS PREV_REUSER_COUNT , IFNULL(RESULT_TB.PREV_USER_AMOUNT, 0) AS PREV_USER_AMOUNT
FROM( SELECT
COUNT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE) AS COUNT , DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FOR_DATE , WEEK(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, 4) AS WEEKCOUNT , DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m') as YEARMONTH , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate}) AS PREV_MB_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(MUIS.SEQ) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER CUS ON MUIS.USER_NO = CUS.USER_NO LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS ON MUIS.SEQ = TRIS.SEQ WHERE CUS.WITHDRAW_DATE < #{fromDate}) AS PREV_WD_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS ON TRIS.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate} AND TRIS.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN='N') AS PREV_USER_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS ON TRIS.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate} ) AS PREV_REUSER_COUNT , (SELECT SUM(TRIS.TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS ON TRIS.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate} AND TRIS.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN='N') AS PREV_USER_AMOUNT
COUNT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE) AS COUNT , DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FOR_DATE , WEEK(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, 4) AS WEEKCOUNT , DATE_FORMAT(CU.WITHDRAW_DATE, '%Y-%m') as YEARMONTH
, TRI.TOTAL_PAYMENT , TRI.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER CU ON CU.USER_NO = MUI.USER_NO LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRI ON MUI.SEQ = TRI.SEQ
WHERE TRI.APPROVAL_DATE > #{fromDate} AND TRI.APPROVAL_DATE < #{toDate}
AND TRI.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN = 'N'
GROUP BY TRI.APPROVAL_DATE
WHERE CU.WITHDRAW_DATE > #{fromDate} AND CU.WITHDRAW_DATE < #{toDate} GROUP BY CU.WITHDRAW_DATE
)RESULT_TB
GROUP BY RESULT_TB.FOR_DATE
GROUP BY RESULT_TB.YEARMONTH
ORDER BY FOR_DATE ASC

SELECT SUM(RESULT_TB.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT , RESULT_TB.FOR_DATE , RESULT_TB.WEEKCOUNT , RESULT_TB.YEARMONTH , (SELECT SUM(TRIS.TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS ON TRIS.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ WHERE MUIS.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE < #{fromDate}) AS PREV_REQUEST_AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(TRIS.TOTAL_PAYMENT) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUIS ON TRIS.SEQ = MUIS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate} ) AS PREV_APPROVED_AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(TRS.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT) FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRIS LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT TRS ON TRIS.SEQ = TRS.SEQ WHERE TRIS.APPROVAL_DATE < #{fromDate}) AS PREV_ORIGINAL_AMOUNT FROM( SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FOR_DATE , WEEK(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, 4) AS WEEKCOUNT , DATE_FORMAT(MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m') as YEARMONTH , TRI.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS AMOUNT
DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FOR_DATE , WEEK(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, 4) AS WEEKCOUNT , DATE_FORMAT(TRI.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m') as YEARMONTH , TRI.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS AMOUNT
DATE_FORMAT(TR.REPAYMENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FOR_DATE , WEEK(TR.REPAYMENT_DATE, 4) AS WEEKCOUNT , DATE_FORMAT(TR.REPAYMENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') as YEARMONTH
, TR.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT
, TR.FEE_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT
, TRI.FINAL_REPAYMENT_YN FROM HELLOPAY_B2B_EXECUTE_INFO TRI LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI ON TRI.SEQ = MUI.SEQ LEFT JOIN HELLOPAY_B2B_REPAYMENT TR ON TRI.SEQ = TR.SEQ
WHERE MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE < #{toDate} GROUP BY MUI.MONEYBANK_REQUEST_DATE
WHERE TR.REPAYMENT_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND TR.REPAYMENT_DATE < #{toDate} GROUP BY TR.REPAYMENT_DATE
)RESULT_TB
GROUP BY RESULT_TB.FOR_DATE
GROUP BY RESULT_TB.YEARMONTH
ORDER BY FOR_DATE ASC
